question: A book seller gives a 4% discount on the marked price and gives one book free during vacation for buying every pack of 15 books of the same cost, and thus gains 35%. By what percentage is the marked price higher than the cost price?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Shopkeeper gives 16 books but charges for 15 with an additional 4% discount on Marked Price.

Effective SP / MP ratio = (15 × 0.96) / 16 = 14.4 / 16 = 90 / 100 ⇒ 10% effective discount.

Using direct formula: CP / MP = (100 − D%) / (100 + P%)

⇒ CP / MP = (100 − 10) / (100 + 35) = 90 / 135 = 2 / 3

⇒ Percentage by which MP is higher than CP = [(3 − 2) / 2] × 100% = 50%.

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**
